description: The engine defaults every OPF engine shares (OPF 0.15). Not part of the document contract and not a catalog: these are the values an engine draws with when a document names no theme, colour scheme or font scheme, or when a reference resolves nowhere (opf/unresolved-reference). They are the drawing fields of the gallery's minimal theme, cool-horizon colour scheme and aptos font scheme, compiled into core (ENGINE_DEFAULT_THEME, ENGINE_DEFAULT_COLOR_SCHEME, ENGINE_DEFAULT_FONT_SCHEME) so preview, pagination, editor and PPTX export use the same fallback without loading any catalog. 'chartTypes' is the order in which an engine offers chart types when it must pick one (chartTypes[0] first).
